prompt.alinti: an open-source CRM that uses an AI agent to research contacts and schedule follow-ups for you.
It reads your emails and meetings, identifies people, enriches company data, and schedules follow-ups automatically.
You set it up with a few commands, connect your Google account, and it starts researching contacts.
Comment CRM, and I'll send you the repo link.

yontem.ne: AI agent tarafından araştırma ve veri girişi otomatikleştirilen CRM.
yontem.alinti: Ada research agent is the product. The database is just where it writes things down.

yontem.ne: Kullanıcı browser'ı kapattığında bile çalışmaya devam eden AI agent.
yontem.alinti: close the browser and it keeps working.

yontem.ne: Agent kendi çalışma kuyruğunu yönetir ve araştırma bütçesi bitene kadar çalışır.
yontem.alinti: It runs on its own schedule, close the browser, and it keeps working. It decides what to look at next, books its own follow-ups, spends a research budget, and stops when the budget runs out.

yontem.ne: Güçlü kanıtlar kaydedilir, zayıf kanıtlar öneri olarak işaretlenir.
yontem.alinti: Strong evidence writes to the record. Weak evidence becomes a suggestion a human settles.

yontem.ne: API'de zaten zekâ yoktur; zekâ agentta yer alır.
yontem.alinti: The API deliberately has no intelligence in it at all.
